_note: The screens' vocabulary (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-06-device-screens.md): the draw items, actions and values ui/screens.js may use, which device.js (the mock) and the device's UI runtime both implement. device.js's problems() and tools/screens/gen.py refuse anything outside it. Adding a word here means implementing it twice: in device.js and in app/ui. items: a draw item's kind (the key that names it) and every key it may carry, in the order the generator numbers them (ui_item_kind). actions: an action's kind ({ go } or { do }) and its other keys (ui_action, after UA_NONE). values: the names a template ({name}) or a condition (when) may read: fixed ones, and patterns: {a-b} a number in that range, {field} a key of screens.js's fields, {row} a row id of rows.js, {line} a key of screens.js's lines. record: a turntable's record, { record: [cx, cy, r], value, color, back, past } (VNL-1's splash and now-playing screens): a disc of radius r centred at (cx, cy) in the band (cy may be negative: a band below the centre; -128..127), in back, five grooves in past, a label of radius r * 5 / 13 in color with a mark that turns with value (a number, 1/256 turns: the cream dot at 0 points right); nothing else may draw over its label, which the device redraws alone as it turns. text's fit: [w, FONT]: wider than w in its font, the text is drawn in FONT instead. go's home: true: the screen becomes the home (HOME's, the one a new song returns to), the device remembers it. A screen's fade: true: its text, rects, icons, meters and sections are drawn mixed toward their band's background by {fade} (a number, 0 as they are .. 16 the background; each channel (c * (16 - f) + bg * f) / 16, rounded down): the splash's text fading out into now playing's (app.c), the device redrawing the text's columns alone (right of the records). lock: { do: "lock", part } locks or unlocks a part (a new song keeps a locked part: app.c; SEQ held on a part's screen), { do: "lock", byCursor: [part | null, ...] } the highlighted menu line's part (SEQ held on the main screen; null: nothing); long: a key's or a button's action when held (a key UI_LONG_MS, a button UI_HOLD_MS: nav.h, device.js), the action itself when let go sooner; lockDrums, lockBass, lockComp, lockLead, lockPad, lockTexture and lockSong (the song line) are true while that part is locked.
